## Summary

Describe the frontend or integration change and its user-visible effect.

## Material Graph scope

- [ ] This change belongs in the Material Graph Studio Open WebUI dependency fork.
- [ ] The pull request targets `main`.
- [ ] A related issue or decision in [`ai4s-fiber/material-graph-studio`](https://github.com/ai4s-fiber/material-graph-studio) is linked when applicable.
- [ ] Upstream changes are identified by their Open WebUI issue, pull request, tag, or commit when applicable.

## Validation

- [ ] Material Graph Pipe and contract tests pass.
- [ ] Material Graph frontend tests pass.
- [ ] The production frontend builds successfully, or the reason it was not run is documented.
- [ ] Screenshots or recordings are attached for visible UI changes.
- [ ] No API keys, model tokens, NAS credentials, secret files, cookies, production data, or complete environment dumps are included.

## Compatibility and licensing

- [ ] Material Graph API, SSE, dynamic-form, and workflow-graph contracts remain compatible or the required coordinated main-project change is linked.
- [ ] Open WebUI attribution, licenses, and applicable notices are preserved.

## Notes

List deployment considerations, migrations, known limitations, or follow-up work.
